monetization.noteEs: Actualmente en Early Access pago (~$30 USD) que da acceso completo al juego durante el desarrollo. GGG anunció que se moverá a free-to-play tras el full release. Las microtransacciones siguen el mismo modelo que PoE 1: cosméticas y stash space, sin power buyable.
monetization.noteEn: Currently in paid Early Access (~$30 USD) granting full game access during development. GGG announced transition to free-to-play after full release. Microtransactions follow the PoE 1 model: cosmetics and stash space, no buyable power.
